why.line1: In digital culture, your brand competes for attention with the cat of the moment and the meme of the week.
why.line2: Topics come and go, and there's always the feeling that everyone is talking about the same thing.
why.question: And why does that happen?
why.answer: Because viral is the sum of <hl>news + entertainment.</hl>
why.formula: The formula that sparks interest and engages millions of people.
why.tide: This tide is a <hl>new opportunity for brands.</hl>

what.line1: We bring together the biggest meme, entertainment and news profiles.
what.line3: The ones that make it feel like everyone is talking about it.

how.title: How it works
how.s1Text: Tell us your goal and pick the pages.
how.s2Text: The post is made in each page's own style, in any agreed format. Nothing goes live without your approval.
how.s3Text: On the date agreed with Groscove, the pages post together, fast and in sync!
how.s4Title: See how big the wave was
how.s4Text: Groscove delivers the indicators and metrics of your wave.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Groscove creates the post in each page's own style.
faq.q2: Does my brand approve before the wave goes live?
faq.a2: Yes. Nothing goes live without your brand's approval.
faq.q3: How long does it take? Can we ride a same-day topic?
faq.a3: Timing is agreed between your brand and Groscove.
faq.a4: Yes, you choose the pages for your wave.
faq.q5: Which formats are included: feed, stories, reels, X?
faq.a5: Any format, agreed in the negotiation with Groscove.
faq.q6: How do I see how big the wave was?
faq.a6: Groscove delivers the indicators and metrics of your wave.
